notes: Find any feature with Ctrl+F (Cmd+F on the Mac), and a guided tour of everything whose card keeps out of your way. Knock out actor: a hit enemy shows an explosion or a knight on the ground, then hides or gets up again. Shots can show a different sprite each way they fly, and big numbers can skip the pause after each point. Map games can switch the score bar off and use all 24 rows, CharPad title screens, and Colour per tile off now shows as the game does.
